headline: Zota Health Care acquires 80% stake in Globotask IT Consultancy Services
sum: Zota Health Care Limited has announced the acquisition of an 80% equity stake in Globotask IT Consultancy Services Private Limited, expanding its technology service capability in the healthcare IT consulting space.
implication: Minority stake retention (20%) by seller signals earn-out or founder retention mechanics; requires review of FEMA approval pathway if any foreign investor involved in Globotask, and tax neutrality under Section 47 ITA 1961 if structured as share-swap.
detail: Zota Health Care, a healthcare-focused listed entity, has acquired control (80%) of Globotask IT Consultancy Services Private Limited, a private IT consulting firm. The deal was disclosed to NSE via formal acquisition notice. Consideration amount, closing conditions, and earnout/holdback terms are not disclosed in the public announcement. The 20% minority stake retained by the seller suggests a phased or conditional payout structure typical in mid-market technology M&A.
